text:
maria (Support): FYI customer NimblyHealth just flagged their March invoice is ~3x what their billing dashboard shows. They attached two screenshots and say usage in dashboard stopped increasing after 03/05 but invoice includes lots of tokens after that. invoice link: https://billing.redwood.ai/invoices/INV-82394

sasha (Billing): Opening the invoice now. Account ID? I want to confirm metering key used.

maria (Support): acct_nimbly_001 — customer says they only called the hosted API from a single backend via our official SDK. They shared SDK logs showing retries but they think retries are idempotent. Screenshot shows invoice total: $12,432 vs dashboard ~$3,900.

jamal (Eng-Ingest): tagging in. Can you grab an example request id from their SDK logs? need the raw X-Request-Id / client-side retry header to trace ingestion events.

maria (Support): They pasted a few lines:

```
2026-03-05T10:12:03Z INFO call id=6b9f5c x-retry-token=retry-4 endpoint=/v1/generate tokens=1200
2026-03-05T10:12:04Z INFO call id=6b9f5c x-retry-token=retry-5 endpoint=/v1/generate tokens=1200
```

ova (DevEx): Looks like their SDK emitted distinct retry tokens for retry attempts (retry-4, retry-5). Our ingestion should dedupe via x-rdwd-id when present, but if SDK sends unique retry token and no id, we might double-count.

meter-bot: Detected anomaly: ingest-pipeline saw a 2.9x increase in token events for acct_nimbly_001 between 2026-03-05 and 2026-03-07. Backfill worker ran 2026-03-06T02:00:12Z for 24h window.

jamal (Eng-Ingest): I pulled ingestion logs for acct_nimbly_001. There were duplicate events from the same client IP with different retry header values, and a backfill job reprocessed an SQS batch where the dedupe-key was empty for those events. Root cause hypothesis: backfill job didn't preserve the original dedupe metadata, so duplicates were re-ingested as new events.

sasha (Billing): If duplicates were ingested and then scored as usage, invoice would include them. Can finance do a provisional credit while we confirm? Customer is already escalated.

tim (Finance): We can issue a provisional credit to avoid customer disruption. Need a conservative amount — suggest crediting the delta between invoice and dashboard minus a 10% buffer while we reconcile: provisional credit = $12,432 - $3,900 = $8,532 -> credit $7,678.4 (rounded $7,679). I need approval from billing manager but can start the credit hold process.

maria (Support): Customer asked for immediate credit and a timeline. They want a clear explanation and that this won't recur.

jamal (Eng-Ingest): Action items from eng:
- repro locally with the customer's SDK logs and the backfill worker config (I have a replay script)
- run a de-dupe sweep to identify events sharing original request fingerprint and mark duplicates for rollback
- add a guard to backfill that preserves dedupe-ids

ova (DevEx): Repro steps for Eng: they can use the customer's two log lines above. Quick replay command we use:

```
python tools/replay_events.py --account acct_nimbly_001 --from 2026-03-05T00:00:00Z --to 2026-03-07T00:00:00Z --inject-headers "x-retry-token"
```

jamal (Eng-Ingest): Running that now on staging. Initial run shows token replays matching exactly the spikes in billing preview. I can produce a small patch to backfill that restores dedupe metadata and then run a rollback job to mark duplicate usage as void.

tim (Finance): Good. Once eng provides a definitive list of duplicate event IDs and token counts we can 1) post a provisional credit immediately, 2) do a final true-up on next billing cycle and issue any additional adjustments, 3) record a revrec note referencing ticket BIL-2471 and support thread.

sasha (Billing): Please send me the CSV of duplicated events (fields: event_id, timestamp, tokens, original_request_fingerprint). I'll prepare the credit memo and attach it to the invoice.

jamal (Eng-Ingest): CSV export ready: https://internal.redwood/ingest/recon/acct_nimbly_001/dup_20260305.csv (internal only). Totals: duplicated_token_count=162,340 tokens; estimated overcharge = $8,412.

tim (Finance): Thanks. I'll provisional-credit $7,679 now and mark for true-up. Finance note: revrec impact will be handled in March close; need GL code 6502-UsageAdjust and reference BIL-2471.

maria (Support): Customer updated: "Thank you. Please fix and confirm once credit applied." They asked whether SDK should change to send permanent request IDs.

ova (DevEx): Recommend SDK change: include `x-rdwd-id` UUID per logical request and preserve it across retries. Also document best-practice: client should retry but keep idempotency key constant.

jamal (Eng-Ingest): I'll put a fix in backfill worker this afternoon to preserve dedupe metadata and schedule the duplicate-void job. Will update thread when rollback completes.

sasha (Billing): Credit applied (provisional): $7,679 — invoice INV-82394 now shows credit memo CM-9987. I updated the invoice note.

tim (Finance): Logged revrec note: "Provisional credit CM-9987 issued pending ingestion reconciliation for acct_nimbly_001. GL:6502. Ticket: BIL-2471."

maria (Support): Customer responded with :relieved: and asked if we'll follow up when the final true-up is done.

jamal (Eng-Ingest): Duplicate-void job finished. We voided the 162,340 duplicated tokens. Final adjustment estimate aligns with CSV. I'll push final reconciliation report in 30m.

sasha (Billing): On receipt of final recon, I'll post the true-up credit/charge and close the provisional credit. Will generate final invoice adjustment and update revenue recognition entries.

tim (Finance): After true-up, I'll update March close entries. Thanks all — good coordination.

maria (Support): Closing loop with customer: "We've issued a provisional credit. We've identified a backfill bug that reprocessed events without dedupe IDs and caused duplicate metering. We've voided duplicated events and will finalize the billing adjustment within 48 hours. We recommend upgrading SDK to v1.4.2 which includes idempotency guidance." Customer: "thanks, appreciated."

jamal (Eng-Ingest): Filed PR to backfill service and added test. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ingest/pull/452

ova (DevEx): Will update SDK docs and add a short example for `x-rdwd-id` usage.

meter-bot: Final reconciliation complete for acct_nimbly_001: net_token_delta = -162340, invoice adjusted. Thread auto-archived.

maria (Support): Thread resolved, marking as resolved in support tracker: SUP-9132.
